scope: Observed official Windows emulator software downloads only. No games, BIOS, firmware, or third-party bundles.

projects.name: Dolphin
projects.notes: Direct Windows x64 release link observed on the official download page. Prefer this release over development snapshots for this archive.

projects.name: Cemu
projects.notes: Official homepage links this release. Resolve its Windows binary through GitHub release assets.

projects.name: PCSX2
projects.notes: Official project repository verified via pcsx2.net. Releases include stable and frequent nightly builds; choose a Windows stable asset when available.

projects.name: RPCS3
projects.notes: Official website returned 403 to the research tool. The official RPCS3 GitHub organization identifies this repository as its Windows x64 binary repository. Binary release page verified.

projects.name: PPSSPP
projects.notes: Free Windows portable ZIP, distinct from paid PPSSPP Gold downloads.

projects.name: xemu
projects.notes: Windows x86_64 link observed directly on official xemu homepage. No BIOS/firmware files included in this mapping.

projects.name: Xenia Master
projects.notes: Official download page labels Master inactive. This is its observed archive link; Canary is the maintained experimental alternative.

projects.name: Xenia Canary
projects.notes: Canary Windows download link observed on the official Xenia download page.

projects.name: mGBA
projects.notes: Windows 64-bit portable archive observed on official download page.

projects.name: Snes9x
projects.notes: Legacy homepage lists mirror sites. Project's own GitHub wiki explicitly recommends the official GitHub releases page; that release page was verified. Resolve a Windows asset there.

projects.name: DeSmuME
projects.notes: Official downloads page names 0.9.13 as stable and links this release. Stable is from 2022; nightly builds remain separately listed.

projects.name: Project64
projects.notes: Portable ZIP target observed through official public releases page and its Try again link. Target has no file extension; use response Content-Disposition if available. GitHub project releases page is empty, so do not treat it as a binary source. Development builds are supporter-only.

projects.name: DuckStation
projects.notes: Direct x64 installer linked in the official repository README. Windows portable ZIPs are documented as release assets; prefer ZIP if the archive script selects one. Preserve files unmodified.

projects.name: ePSXe
projects.notes: Official homepage HTML navigation points to download.php. That page and the v2.0.18 Windows binary target were observed. No BIOS files included.
